scope: Static read-only source, text and hash inspection; no node execution, tests, browsers, builds or containers; external review artifact only

sourceInspection.syntaxAssessment: Insertion boundaries and referenced lexical bindings inspected; no parser or browser execution performed. All probes insert statements within existing function bodies; original control statements retained.
sourceInspection.originalStartupAssertions: Actual bench.check runs before successful stop marker; actual bench.done retains original 15s deadline. runWorkload retains original 45s timeout and finally context.close.
sourceInspection.exactMode: Original evaluate awaited before any observer evaluate. Host listener/bookkeeping overhead still changes timing.
sourceInspection.traceMode: Content mutated only in frozen in-memory baseline map; original and transformed identities separate. __bench state/begin/check are wrapped, retaining original functions; trace-only overhead affects timings.
sourceInspection.limits: 12000 stored events, dropped counts retained, mutations truncate targets/attributes. Queue stack and mutation serialization still run after cap; cap bounds stored events rather than total instrumentation work. Page errors/console arrays currently uncapped.

findings.finding: Every failure becomes original-startup-failed, including setup, probe exceptions, CDP failure, context timeout and cleanup failure. The status cannot distinguish original assertions from invalid diagnostic runs.
findings.minimalExternalFix: Store original done/check rejection identity separately; classify setup/probe/timeout/context cleanup/observation failures as diagnostic or infrastructure errors; use nonzero process exit for invalid diagnostic runs. Keep original thrown exception bytes unchanged.

findings.finding: Initial checkout and harness identities are recorded but not enforced against exact clean c38 and reviewed identities; stability only proves no later change.
findings.minimalExternalFix: Before browser launch require expected commit and empty git status, and compare current source/harness/script hashes with separately frozen reviewed expectations. Record and check script identity after execution as well.

findings.finding: Stopping after startup intentionally never reaches original final browser-errors assertion. Captured pageErrors/crash remain report fields but do not invalidate startup-completed-diagnostic status; unexpected resource errors in private harness errors are not visible in report.
findings.minimalExternalFix: Keep startup-check-passed as a narrow fact; separately surface captured page/crash and failed resource requests as diagnostic invalidity. Do not describe startup-prefix execution as preserving execution of all end-of-workload assertions.

findings.finding: After-failure-only pending observation is later than failed check; it cannot atomically establish pending as the check cause. In the observed healthy active revision1 snapshot, synchronous refresh cannot remain running while independent host evaluation executes; a pending timer is strongly source-supported, but origin remains unresolved.
findings.requirement: Reading cause requires reproduced done-resolution then accepted queue with attributable event/call stack then rejected original check state. Traced passing startup plus late queue does not explain immutable primary failure.

findings.finding: Inline addScriptTag content has no src; parent supplied HTML script-execution criterion disfavours native inline script-load hypothesis. Font loadingdone is plausible from source but remains unproved; other events must be traced.
findings.requirement: Avoid describing inline script load as likely. Event and accepted queue chronology must support origin.

evidenceAndSourceDistinction.historicalPrimary: Retained primary status error; first reading80 baseline warmup; zero baseline/candidate measured samples. Does not establish candidate regression.
evidenceAndSourceDistinction.afterFailure: Later reading observation healthy active pending revision1 with loaded correct typography; conversation timeout later observation revision21. Neither identifies causal event.
evidenceAndSourceDistinction.conversationSource: Fixture author observer restores label cssText; historical retention writes inline values and authored deliveries schedule invalidateAutoContent. Source supports a feedback hypothesis, not executed causality. Need repeated observed author label writes, authored deliveries and accepted refreshes; finite reviewed intervention may strengthen causal attribution.
evidenceAndSourceDistinction.controls: Suppression changes instrumented behaviour and cannot qualify original published baseline. Any recovery after disconnect is diagnostic only.
evidenceAndSourceDistinction.primary: One unchanged full default3x5 command versus f267 after trace, retained new output, exact clean c38 candidate. Unmatched failure remains blocking; no fallback or green hunting.

readiness.technical: Conditional; external script bookkeeping/identity fixes F1-F3 need followup static review before validation release. Probe insertion approach is appropriate diagnostic scope.
readiness.intervention: Not approved or implemented; must review concrete finite intervention after trace.
readiness.release: Blocked; review provides no policy or publication authorization.
